ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming upgrades are not a current interest shown by my purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Wired audio fits my past headset purchase, but I would not buy another pair without a replacement need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying a tablet mount does not mean I currently need another tablet.

ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My display cable purchase was DVI; I would need to confirm an HDMI connection need before considering this.
